sentence: This project studies how a driver's cognitive workload and emotional state can be measured to decide when driving automation should step in.
This project develops algorithms that use a finite number of measurements to predict how a physical system behaves when its boundary is unknown.
This project develops theories and computational methods that make quantum sensing more accurate, using machine learning and quantum dynamics calculations.
This project builds an open-source ecosystem around a software framework that gives robots natural spoken dialogue.
This project stacks twisted layers of 2D materials and uses machine learning to design material properties and build devices.
This project compares biologging data with at sea survey data to check how well biologging describes marine mammals and sea birds.
This project builds a way for robots to answer what if questions about their surroundings and themselves, preparing them for unforeseen events.
This project studies how kidney tubular epithelial cells take in and handle fatty acid when there is excess energy and nutrients.
This project builds digital twins that learn by themselves so they can predict and adjust to uncertain manufacturing conditions.
This project develops a hardware accelerator that puts processing elements inside memory so learning from a few training samples uses less energy.
This project studies software that lowers the hardware a fault-tolerant quantum computer needs by optimizing its software, error correction and machine together.
This project creates courses and learning materials about quantum computing.
This project studies how robots can learn new tasks from everyday users by reusing skills and knowledge learned from other robots.
This project studies how genetic diversity and the way seaweeds reproduce change with latitude.
This project builds a tool that finds vulnerabilities in container images and a secure way to run containers for high-performance computing.
This project develops methods to explain what happens inside deep neural networks using human-understandable concepts and to make the networks robust.
This project studies the molecular and physical properties of prey capture glues made by spiders, flies and velvet worms.
This project studies how extreme climate and weather events change the numbers of mosquitoes, butterflies and moths, and ground beetles.
